subject: english
title: Long vowel spellings
titleId: Ejaan vokal panjang: ai/ay, ee/ea, igh/ie, oa/ow, oo
canDo: I can choose the right spelling for a long vowel sound, like rain, play, boat and snow.

subject: english
title: Magic e words
titleId: Huruf e ajaib: a_e, i_e, o_e, u_e
canDo: I can read and spell words like cake, bike, home and cube.

subject: english
title: Tricky words for Grade 2
canDo: I can spell tricky words like because, people, friend and could.

subject: english
title: Synonyms and opposites
titleId: Sinonim dan lawan kata (termasuk awalan un-)
canDo: I can find words that mean the same and words that mean the opposite.

subject: english
title: Describing words
canDo: I can choose describing words and use -er and -est to compare.

subject: english
title: Nouns and plurals
titleId: Kata benda, nama diri, dan bentuk jamak
canDo: I can find nouns, give names a capital letter and write plurals with -s, -es and -ies.

subject: english
title: Pronouns
canDo: I can use he, she, it, we and they instead of saying a name again.

subject: english
title: Past tense with -ed
canDo: I can add -ed to a verb to talk about the past.

subject: english
title: Past tense words that change
canDo: I can use past tense words like went, saw, ate and ran.

subject: english
title: Joining words: and, but, because, so
titleId: Kata sambung and, but, because, dan so
canDo: I can join two ideas with and, but, because or so.

subject: english
title: Full stops, question marks and exclamation marks
titleId: Titik, tanda tanya, tanda seru, dan huruf kapital
canDo: I can end a sentence with a full stop, a question mark or an exclamation mark.

subject: english
title: Commas in lists and short forms like don't
titleId: Koma dalam daftar dan apostrof untuk bentuk singkat
canDo: I can put commas in a list and use an apostrophe in short forms like don't and it's.

subject: english
title: Finding and working out answers
titleId: Mencari fakta dan menyimpulkan dari bacaan
canDo: I can find facts in a text and work out how a character feels and why.

subject: english
title: Story order, instructions and fact texts
titleId: Urutan cerita, teks petunjuk, dan teks informasi
canDo: I can put events in order and spot the parts of stories, instructions and fact texts.

subject: english
title: Poems, rhyme and sound words
titleId: Puisi, rima, dan kata tiruan bunyi
canDo: I can find rhyming words and sound words in a poem and say what a line means.

subject: english
title: Writing recounts and instructions
canDo: I can write about something I did and write steps with first, next, then and finally.

subject: english
title: Speaking and reading aloud
canDo: I can retell a story, describe something clearly and read aloud with expression.
